medium: VISUAL_GAMEPLAY_LEGIBILITY — The evidence record is rendered at 11px inside a 34px scroll viewport, exposing only roughly two rows despite up to seven core evidence rows plus reopen/report events. The specified tap-to-expand behavior is absent, making comparison of flow and sound evidence unnecessarily difficult for ages 10–12. This is usable but below the design's 56px/expandable presentation.

failure_codes.finding: The critical record history uses 11px text and a 34px viewport without the specified tap-to-expand interaction; children must scroll through a narrow two-row window to compare up to seven or more events.
